locale.label: Language
locale.hint: Default follows Windows language. You can change it anytime.

connect.screenOff: Turn phone screen off while mirroring
connect.screenOffHint: Control still works; only the phone display is off.

guide.title: Connect your phone
guide.subtitle: USB setup once. The device appears here automatically.
guide.step1Body: Settings → About phone → tap Build number seven times.
guide.step3Body: Use a data cable, not charge-only.
guide.step4Body: Accept “Allow USB debugging” on the phone, and enable Always allow from this computer.
guide.after1: Start mirror: the phone screen opens in a separate window, with a toolbar on the PC.
guide.after2: Pick a performance preset that fits your laptop and cable.
guide.after3: Screenshots and recordings save under PixMirror — changeable in Settings.
guide.after4: Turn phone screen off while mirroring if you want privacy at your desk.
guide.waitingAuth: Waiting for your approval on the phone… Choose Always allow from this computer.
guide.offlineHint: Device is offline — unplug and reconnect the cable.

presets.label: Performance
presets.highDesc: Sharpest picture. Good for work and detail.

mirror.endedUnexpectedly: Mirroring ended. The display window may have closed, USB dropped, or the phone screen turned off.

settings.title: Settings
settings.saveDirHint: Screenshots in screenshots/, recordings in recordings/.

errors.unauthorized: Device is connected but unauthorized. Accept “Allow USB debugging” on the phone (enable Always allow from this computer).
errors.no_device: No device connected. Plug in the phone and enable USB debugging.
errors.offline: Device is offline. Unplug and reconnect, or toggle USB debugging on the phone.
errors.adb_daemon: Could not start the adb server. Make sure no other adb is running, then try again.
errors.multiple_devices: More than one device is connected. Select a specific device first.
errors.mirror_already: Mirroring is already running. Stop it first.
errors.binaries_missing: Binaries folder missing. Place files under src-tauri/binaries.
errors.bad_path: A required file path is missing or invalid. Reinstall the app or restore the binaries folder.
errors.screenshot_invalid: Could not capture a valid image from the device
errors.path_outside_save: Path is outside the save folder.
